description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notifying that the order effective from 15.12.2015 and the Excise Notifying No. 984 published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1945/17 of 15.12.2015 were passed by the Parliament on 10.03.2016
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of excise license fees and regulations through a statutory order issued by the Minister of Finance under the Excise Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework update with detailed fee schedules for various liquor-related licenses, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories.
